summary: Server singleton: stack-split requests made by pick-ups (pick up part of a stack), filled by esv::pickup::PickUpSplitRequestSystem and consumed by esv::inventory::StackSystem::ProcessPickUpSplitRequests. Same element as esv::drop::SplitRequestSingletonComponent. Seen.py context: idle level.

fields.name: Item
fields.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0xF4CD00 StackSystem::ProcessPickUpSplitRequests copies element +0 (qword) to StackSystem::DirectRequest +0 - the stack entity to split. Element is esv::inventory_transfer::SplitRequest (see the alive layout esv.drop.SplitRequestSingletonComponent, which declares the same members). Windows: the per-frame update of esv::pickup::PickUpSplitRequestSystem (bg3.exe+0x35C1530, lines ~236-262) appends 0x20-byte elements to the request array (growth FUN_1406DA440, index*0x20): element+0 = the qword at +8 of the pick-up request (the stack entity).

fields.name: field_8
fields.evidence: Four dwords at +8..+0x18 copied into DirectRequest +8..+0x18; a ls::Guid in the drop split request analysis (request id). Windows: the per-frame update of esv::pickup::PickUpSplitRequestSystem (bg3.exe+0x35C1530, lines ~236-262) appends 0x20-byte elements to the request array (growth FUN_1406DA440, index*0x20): element+8..+0x17 = 16 bytes taken from a second component of the same entity (two qwords).

fields.name: Amount
fields.evidence: Dword at +0x18 copied to DirectRequest +0x18 (the amount to split off). Windows: the per-frame update of esv::pickup::PickUpSplitRequestSystem (bg3.exe+0x35C1530, lines ~236-262) appends 0x20-byte elements to the request array (growth FUN_1406DA440, index*0x20): element+0x18 = the dword at +0x10 of the pick-up request (the requested amount; only when it is smaller than the stack's amount).

fields.name: _Pad1C
fields.evidence: Padding to the 0x20 stride. Windows: the per-frame update of esv::pickup::PickUpSplitRequestSystem (bg3.exe+0x35C1530, lines ~236-262) appends 0x20-byte elements to the request array (growth FUN_1406DA440, index*0x20): element+0x1C = high half of a stack local that is never assigned: padding.

fields.name: Requests
fields.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0xF4CD00 esv::inventory::StackSystem::ProcessPickUpSplitRequests gets the singleton (FUN_180f3a370) and iterates *(ptr) for size *(+0xC) with stride 0x20 (puVar11 += 4 qwords), appending ls::IndexedStorage<esv::inventory::StackSystem::DirectRequest>. Live (idle): all zero. Windows writer bg3.exe+0x35C1530 confirms the 0x20 stride; adder bg3.exe+0x35C2180 zeroes the array.
